Logs.title: Logs
Logs.wikitext:
{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Redirect|Log}} {{Infobox Item |name = Logs |image = [[File:Logs.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = A number of wooden logs. |value = 4 |weight = 2.000 |respawn = 100 |exchange = Yes |id = 1511 }} [[File:Logs detail.png|left|130px]] '''Logs''', also called '''normal logs''', are obtained from [[woodcutting|cutting]] [[Regular tree|regular]], [[evergreen tree|evergreen]], [[Jungle tree|jungle]], [[Dying tree|dying]] and [[dead tree]]s, and uncommonly from [[infected root]]s. Players can burn these logs using the [[Firemaking]] [[skill]]. Cutting the logs gives 25 [[Woodcutting]] [[experience]], and burning them gives 40 Firemaking experience. These logs have no requirement to be cut or burnt. [[Members]] training [[Construction]] can bring logs to a [[sawmill]] to make [[planks]] at a cost of 100 [[coins]] each. Alternatively, the [[Lunar spell]] [[Plank Make]] can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of [[runes]]. While wearing [[Kandarin headgear 1]] or higher, normal trees anywhere give double logs when chopped down but no additional experience is provided. It is currently the only log which can be coloured with [[gnomish firelighters]], which are obtained as rewards from [[Treasure Trails]]. These firelighters produce fire in one of five predetermined colours: red, blue, green, purple, or white. Coloured logs also give 50 Firemaking experience, slightly more than lighting the logs normally. {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" |Firelighters ! colspan="2" |Logs |- |{{plinkt|White firelighter}} |{{plinkt|White logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Red firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Red logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Purple firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Purple logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Green firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Green logs}} |- |{{plinkt|Blue firelighter}} |{{plinkt|Blue logs}} |} [[Members]] can also [[fletching|fletch]] these logs into [[bow]]s and [[arrow shaft]]s, and are the only type of log that can be made into [[javelin shaft]]s. Normal logs are also used to travel to [[Entrana]] or [[Taverley]] using the [[Balloon Transport System]] during and after the [[Enlightened Journey]] quest. ==Skill info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Tree |level = 1 |xp = 25 |tree = [[Tree]] |tool = [[Axe]] |time = 35.4 - 58.8 seconds }} {{Firemaking info |craftxp = 10 |bowlevel = 21 |pyrelevel = 11 |version1 = Tinderbox |version2 = Bow |version3 = Barbarian pyre |version4 = Bonfire |skill2name = Crafting |name = Logs |skill1lvl1 = 1 |skill1lvl2 = 21 |skill1lvl3 = 11 |skill2lvl3 = 1 |skill1lvl4 = 1 |skill1exp1 = 40 |skill1exp2 = 40 |skill1exp3 = 40 |skill1exp4 = 40 |facility1 = N/A |facility2 = N/A |facility3 = [[Funeral pyre (Barbarian)|Barbarian funeral pyre]] |facility4 = [[Fire]] or [[Forester's Campfire]] |tool1 = [[Tinderbox]] |tool2 = [[Bow]] |tool3 = [[Tinderbox]] or [[bow]], and an [[axe]] |tool4 = N/A |type = logs }} ==Uses== ===Firemaking=== {{Main|Firemaking}} A player only needs level 1 [[Firemaking]] and a [[tinderbox]] to turn a normal tree's [[logs]] into a [[fire]], granting 40 [[experience]]. The [[infernal axe]] provides a 1/3 chance of burning any log received when cutting trees. The player gains 20 Firemaking experience when cutting trees, half the experience gained from burning the log normally. If the Kandarin headgear 1 or above is worn in conjunction with the infernal axe, only one log is burned when a tree section is cut. ===Construction=== {{Main|Construction}} Logs may be turned into [[plank]]s at a [[Sawmill]] for use in [[Construction]] for 100 [[coins]] each. Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert the logs to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes. ===Fletching=== {{Main|Fletching}} Logs from normal trees can be cut into 15 [[arrow shafts]] at level 1 [[Fletching]] (granting 5 Fletching [[experience]]), 15 [[javelin shaft]]s at level 3 (granting 5 Fletching experience), [[shortbow]]s at level 5 (granting 5 XP for unstrung and another 5 experience for stringing), [[longbow]]s at level 10 (granting 10 experience for unstrung and another 10 experience for stringing), and [[crossbow stock]]s at level 9 Tree.wikitext:
{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|the [[Woodcutting]] trees}} {{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Double canopy |version2 = Single canopy |version3 = Single canopy, dark |version4 = Pine |version5 = Double canopy, dark |name = Tree |image1 = [[File:Tree.png|x300px]] |image2 = [[File:Tree (single canopy).png|x300px]] |image3 = [[File:Tree (single canopy, dark).png|x300px]] |image4 = [[File:Tree (pine).png|x300px]] |image5 = [[File:Tree (double canopy, dark).png|x300px]] |release1 = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |release2 = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |release3 = [[7 January]] [[2016]] |release4 = |release5 = [[19 November]] [[2025]] |update1 = Runescape beta is now online! |update2 = Runescape beta is now online! |update3 = Zeah: Great Kourend |update4 = |update5 = Sailing is OUT TODAY! |members = No |quest = No |location = Varies |options = Chop down |icon1 = [[File:Map icon - Tree 1.png]] |icon2 = [[File:Map icon - Tree 2.png]] |icon3 = [[File:Map icon - Tree 2.png]] |icon4 = [[File:Map icon - Pine.png]] |icon5 = [[File:Map icon - Tree 1.png]] |examine1 = One of the most common trees in Gielinor. |examine2 = A commonly found tree. |examine3 = A commonly found tree. |examine4 = A commonly found tree. |examine5 = One of the most common trees in Gielinor. |map = No |id1 = 1276 |id2 = 1278 |id3 = 1279 |id4 = 52823 |id5 = 58540 |leagueRegion1 = Misthalin,Asgarnia,Morytania,Kandarin,Fremennik,Wilderness,Kourend,Karamja,Varlamore |leagueRegion2 = Misthalin,Asgarnia,Morytania,Kandarin,Fremennik,Wilderness,Kourend,Varlamore |leagueRegion3 = Kourend,Varlamore |leagueRegion4 = Varlamore |leagueRegion5 = None }} '''Trees''' are the most common [[scenery]] found almost everywhere around [[Gielinor]], and can be chopped down to provide [[logs]] and 25 [[Woodcutting]] experience. The most common varieties of regular trees in [[Gielinor]] are a double canopy tree with round leaves, and a single canopy with a pointy tip. The single canopy and pine varieties can be used with a [[knife]] to fill a [[bucket of sap]] from an empty [[bucket]]; the double canopy variants do not provide sap. The trees can also be distinguished by their examine text and the icon that appears on the minimap, with the double canopy tree showing a round tree icon ([[File:Map icon - Tree 1.png]]), the single canopy variety showing a pointy-tipped icon ([[File:Map icon - Tree 2.png]]), and the pine variant showing a pine ([[File:Map icon - Pine.png]]). Many other variants of trees also provide regular logs and have the same mechanics as regular trees. These include a number of variants all called "tree", such as those found in [[Tree (Tirannwn)|Tirannwn]], [[Tree (Prifddinas)|Prifddinas]], the [[Tree (Isle of Souls)|Isle of Souls]], and [[Tree (Shayzien)|Shayzien]]. There are also cosmetic variants that are [[Tree (young)|young]], [[Tree (crystal)|crystalline]], and [[Tree (snow)|snow covered]]. Other trees that form the regular tree category include [[Dying tree|dying trees]], [[Dead tree|dead trees]], [[evergreen]]s, and [[jungle tree]]s. ==Tree locations== Trees are extremely common in almost every part of [[Gielinor]]. Some more popular spots to cut regular trees are near the bank in [[Draynor Village]], as well as in the areas surrounding the [[Grand Exchange]] and [[Varrock West Bank]]. On [[Karamja]], in [[Morytania]], the [[Kharidian Desert]] and several tropical islands, regular trees are less common or even rare. Most trees on Karamja cannot be cut down. The [[Wilderness]] also lacks trees beyond level 10, where [[Dead tree|dead trees]] are found instead. ==Woodcutting info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Tree |level = 1 |xp = 25 |tool = [[Axe]] |time = 35.4 - 58.8 seconds }} {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Logs|quantity=1|rarity=Always|skill=Woodcutting}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Conditional drops=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Beaver|quantity=1|rarity=Very rare|raritynotes=At level 1 Woodcutting there is a 1 in 317,622 chance to receive the beaver and a 1 in 315,172 chance at level 99.|skill=Woodcutting}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Loop half of key (moon key)|quantity=1|rarity=1/2117|raritynotes=The Loop half of key (moon key) can only be received in [[Varlamore]].|skill=Woodcutting|leagueRegion=Varlamore}} {{DropsTableBottom}} *[[Clue nest]] – Trees have a chance of dropping any tier of clue nest, based on Woodcutting level, the tree's base chance, and access to the reward tiers of [[Combat Achievements]]. See [[Clue nest#Woodcutting rates|Clue nest § Woodcutting rates]] for a detailed breakdown. ==Mechanics== The regular tree category includes trees that give regular logs when cut down. Trees in this category are always felled after one log has been cut. The tree respawns between 36–60 seconds, randomly, and is not influenced by world population.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1161764474078015490|date=14 August 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107113|archivedate=30 May 2020}} The chance to successfully chop is affected by the [[axe]] used and Woodcutting level, better axes and a higher woodcutting level increases the likelihood of successfully receiving a log. [[Kandarin headgear 1]] and above gives double logs when cutting any normal tree. ===Cut chance=== {{Skilling success chart|label=Normal tree cut chance|xlabel=Woodcutting level |label1=Bronze|low1=64|high1=200|req1=1|color1=saddlebrown|image1=Bronze axe.png |label2=Iron|low2=96|high2=300|req2=1|color2=dimgray|image2=Iron axe.png |label3=Steel|low3=128|high3=400|req3=6|color3=lightgray|image3=Steel axe.png |label4=Black|low4=144|high4=450|req4=11|color4=black|image4=Black axe.png |label5=Mithril|low5=160|high5=500|req5=21|color5=slateblue|image5=Mithril axe.png |label6=Adamant|low6=192|high6=600|req6=31|color6=seagreen|image6=Adamant axe.png |label7=Rune|low7=224|high7=700|req7=41|color7=steelblue|image7=Rune axe.png |label8=Dragon|low8=240|high8=750|req8=61|color8=firebrick|image8=Dragon axe.png |label9=Crystal|low9=250|high9=800|req9=71|color9=cyan|image9=Crystal axe.png }} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 20 March 2024 |update = Varlamore: Part One |change = Shadows on normal trees were removed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 30 November 2022 |update = The Garden of Death & More |change = Cutting normal trees (and other activities) on [[Miscellania]] now grant the full 25 experience. Thus, these were the only way to train Woodcutting, all the way to level 99. Higher-level tree types were only added a year later, as part of the [[Fletching]] skill. *Trees that do not have a Chop-down option appear around the [[Drill Demon]]'s training area. These include the version with a double canopy, and a version with a single canopy that has a dark bark (like the variety found in the [[Great Kourend]]), that are the same size as regular trees (unlike the variety found in the [[Great Kourend]]). *While regular trees drop clue nests, they do not drop any other type of [[bird nest]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1255776344295837696|date=30 April 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98238|archivedate=17 April 2022|quote=I'm afraid I'm not going to be available to check all such scenery pieces with those names, but generic & achey trees do give clue nests. However they don't give the other kinds of nest.|notes=|name=|group=}} *The dark single canopy tree variant was present in the game cache since 2001, but remained unused until the release of Great Kourend in 2016. *With the release of [[Varlamore]], trees across the game had the shadows removed from their north-eastern faces. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Trees}} [[Category:Woodcutting]]
